abstract: Seven tumor markers (CA125, CA19-9, TPA, IAP, CEA, ferritin, LDH) were measured in 24 patients with ovarian cancer. The positive rates in untreated cases of ovarian cancer were 87.5% for CA125, 35.5% for CA19-9, 10% for CEA, 77.8% for IAP, 63.6% for TPA, 28.6% for LDH and 35.3% for ferritin. Among these, CA125 was the most available marker for detecting tumor growth or regression during each respective clinical course by serial measurement. Serial changes in serum alpha-fetoprotein (AFP) levels during treatment were studied among 27 patients with ovarian embryonal carcinoma. AFP decreased with a half-life of about 7 days, and was restored to the normal range within 10 weeks after the initial surgery and chemotherapy (VAC) in all cases. In subsequently fatal cases, AFP rose again during 10 to 30 weeks after the initial treatment.
abstract_ja: 卵巣悪性腫瘍患者24例で、7種類の腫瘍マーカー(CA125、CA19-9、TPA、IAP、CEA、フェリチン、LDH)を測定した。未治療の卵巣癌における陽性率は、CA125 87.5%、CA19-9 35.5%、CEA 10%、IAP 77.8%、TPA 63.6%、LDH 28.6%、フェリチン 35.3%であった。これらのうち、CA125は経時的測定により、各臨床経過における腫瘍の増大または縮小の検出に最も有用なマーカーであった。卵巣胎児性癌27例では、治療中の血清αフェトプロテイン(AFP)値の推移を検討した。AFPは半減期約7日で低下し、初回手術およびVAC化学療法後10週以内に全例で正常範囲に回復した。その後死亡した症例では、初回治療後10〜30週の間にAFPが再上昇した。
